name: HydroSHEDS Global Hydrographic Data and River Networks
description: HydroSHEDS (Hydrological data and maps based on SHuttle Elevation Derivatives at multiple Scales) is a globally consistent hydrographic database developed by McGill University, WWF, and USGS. Derived primarily from elevation data obtained during NASA's Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) at 3 arc-second (~90 m) resolution, HydroSHEDS provides hydrologically conditioned elevation, flow direction (DIR), flow accumulation (ACC), vector stream networks (FreeFlow, HydroRIVERS), and hierarchical catchment delineations (HydroBASINS across 12 Pfafstetter coding levels).
